about: The Mods screen's layout, in units (the screen's height / 720). Read by the mockup (tools/mods/mockup/: tools/uikit/uikit.js sets every number below as a CSS custom property, --w- and its path, which mods.css lays out with) and by the DLL (tagpu/ddraw/src/tagpu_modslay.c). tools/mods/modslaycheck.py compares the two. A pair is [vertical, horizontal] and a quad [top, right, bottom, left], as in CSS; `wt` is [left, right, top, height]. The frame's depths (`wt`, `wb`, `gap`, `pn`) are the wiki's, read off the same `window` and `panel` parts.
roles_about: Each text of the screen in the replay HUD's style nearest its role (art/hud/layout.json `styles`), as the wiki's: the titles in the stats window's title; a mod's name and an option in a player row's name; the running text in the stats window's foot, its one mixed-case style; what the list says when empty and a note, each written for the moment, in the toast; the tabs and the footer's buttons in the transport's labels; a row's button, a badge and a reset in the stats window's chips; a value and a stepper's signs in the HUD's numbers.
